pages.title: Ring Restoration Oil
pages.text: Infected slime and node shards boil down into a thick, golden oil. Anoint your rings with it and 100 durability returns to them.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: The oil is shared fairly among every worn ring you carry: in your hands, in your bag and inside your gauntlet. If none of your rings is worn, the oil stays in its bottle.

pages.title: Recipe
notes: Place Somnium and loran energy in the upper input slots.
Place the required items in the test tubes on the left and right.
